title: Opening Range First Retest
summary: Of sessions whose opening range first broke in the chosen direction, how often price later returned to the broken boundary. The breakout bar itself is excluded, so a wide break candle cannot count as its own retest.
deltas: measures the first return to the broken OR boundary after the breakout bar
time-to-retest distribution attached to every run
compose with weekday, gap, event-day, and volatility conditions
